name: local-ocr-gui
description: Offline OCR desktop app built with Electron, React, and PP-OCRv5
author: iwen-conf

scripts.build: node ./scripts/prepare-paddle-models.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: node ./scripts/prepare-paddle-models.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node ./scripts/prepare-paddle-models.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never --mac dir
scripts.dist:win: node ./scripts/prepare-paddle-models.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.dist:win:dir: node ./scripts/prepare-paddle-models.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never --win dir --x64
